defs.meaning: 推迟，延缓；把……放在次要地位；把……放在后面

examples.en: I, for one, would prefer to postpone the meeting.
examples.zh: 主张推迟会期的，我就是一个。

examples.en: It was an unpopular decision to postpone building the new hospital.
examples.zh: 延迟兴建新医院的决定是不得人心的。

examples.en: It is totally out of the question to postpone the midnight deadline.
examples.zh: 延迟午夜的最后期限是根本不可能的。

synonyms.meaning: 使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面
